description: This file defines the XmlBody class responsible for serializing PHP data structures into XML format for REST-XML services within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for building XML documents and handling different data shapes such as structures, lists, maps, and primitives.

classes.name: XmlBody
classes.description: Handles the serialization of data into XML for AWS REST-XML services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the XmlBody with an API service instance.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an XML string based on a given shape and arguments.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Starts an XML element, adding namespace attributes if present.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Dispatches the formatting to specific shape handlers based on type.

methods.name: defaultShape
methods.description: Handles default serialization for simple types.

methods.name: add_map
methods.description: Serializes map shapes into XML with key-value pairs.

methods.name: add_blob
methods.description: Serializes binary data as base64-encoded string.

methods.name: add_timestamp
methods.description: Serializes timestamp shapes using specified format.

methods.name: add_string
methods.description: Serializes string values, as attributes if specified.
